note: Historic guest ranch (operating since 1944) with a real RV park, on Hwy 149 between South Fork and Creede; cabins, on-site restaurant (149 Eatery), gift shop, ice cream shop, jeep and horse rides, 1/4 mile of private Rio Grande access. The RV park is on the lodge side of the highway facing the cliffs and pasture, not on the river; the river frontage is on the river-side cabins. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its ResNexus engine: fees -> $60-65 (2027 standard rate, most sites 2-night minimum), full hookups with 30- and 50-amp classes, 29 RV sites (mostly pull-through; site 4 a back-in under 25 ft), wifi, season May 18 - Sep 30 (2026 dates), online booking (ResNexus) with deposit/refund terms; military cleared (directory only). Gate: $60 > US$50 with no gateway within 40 km -> flag. Note: dropped site/hookup/season/booking restatements and corrected the river side.
flags: PRICE GATE FAIL: 2027 standard rate $60/night (most sites, 2-night minimum) and $65 on sites 13/19/20 - over US$50, and no gateway within 40 km (nearest Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP and Great Sand Dunes NP, 115 km). The family has not stayed here. Candidate drop under the price-gate rule.
Standing 2-night minimum on most RV sites (every sampled night, June and August 2027); a 2-night minimum stays if marked (memory feedback_minimum_stay). Recorded in booking.min_stay.

Long-stay check: monthly RVs are mentioned ('except monthly RV's, full month will be required for deposit'), but every RV site is sold nightly on ResNexus at a posted rate; not long-stay in character.

Waterfront: the stored note's '(riverbank is the cabin/lodge side)' was wrong - the operator puts the RV park on the 'Lodge Side of the Highway' and the river frontage on the river-side cabins. Stored 'not waterfront' unchanged.
Max rig length is not stated anywhere; only site 4 (<25 ft back-in) has a length.
